name: The British Bombshells
caption: Two English wrestlers -- one a battle-tested veteran, one a raw recruit Shea London brought over from the UK -- teaming for BRA's own final 2001 season.

tenures.source: the site's own tag-team roster page and this team's own biography page

name: East/West
caption: A Japanese-American heel tag team, self-described adrenaline junkies who “don't look for trouble -- they find it,” contesting BRA's own final-season Tag Team Championship.

tenures.source: the site's own tag-team roster page and this team's own biography page
Billed on the promotion's own card of 24 May 2002 for its inaugural Tournament of Champions; the show is not recorded as having been staged.

name: The Boone Sisters
caption: Half-sisters from a Mississippi dirt farm who lost fight after fight on the way up before a BRA scout signed them.

tenures.source: the site's own tag-team roster page and this team's own biography page

name: Young and Restless
caption: Two proteges of the Boise Semi-pro Wrestling Club, with their manager and trainer Dani Cuthbert occasionally wrestling as a third.

tenures.source: the site's own tag-team roster page and this team's own biography page

name: The Heavenly Bodies
caption: A heel tag team Delilah Strain brought into BRA as her own, of uncertain prior wrestling background per the site's own record.

tenures.source: the site's own tag-team roster page and this team's own biography page

name: The Plush Sisters
caption: A rookie sister duo who debuted against East/West and repeatedly interfered in the Eastern Continental Championship picture on Stacey Buffington's behalf.

tenures.source: Billed on the promotion's own cards.

name: Business and Pleasure
caption: Tiffany Lane and Alexandria Parker's Sisterhood of Seduction tag team, formed on short notice to win the World Tag Team Championship from Mixie Locke and Maxine Holmes.

tenures.source: Billed on the promotion's own cards.

name: Bad Seed
caption: A debuting tag team of Rachel Sabbato and Jeanmarie Ferguson, targeting the World Tag Team Championship.

tenures.source: Billed on the promotion's own cards.
